title: 06 - Event Platform
description: ¿Funciona correctamente la plataforma de datos? Volumen, tránsito entre capas, rechazos, duplicados y frescura de IoT y AEMET.

panels.title: Entregas recibidas · Bronze
panels.description: Cada entrega Kafka recibida; incluye duplicados e inválidos para preservar auditoría.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM tfm.bronze.matter_events

panels.title: Eventos aceptados · Silver
panels.description: Eventos lógicos únicos aceptados por el contrato; una repetición no duplica Silver.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events

panels.title: Desechadas · Cuarentena
panels.description: Entregas que no superaron las reglas de calidad y se conservan para auditoría.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM tfm.iot_quality.quarantine_events

panels.title: Ventanas calculadas · Gold 5 min
panels.description: Agregados de cinco minutos derivados desde Silver.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM tfm.gold.entity_5m

panels.title: Entregas recibidas por 5 minutos y origen

targets.rawSQL: SELECT date_trunc('minute', kafka_timestamp) - INTERVAL '1' MINUTE * (minute(kafka_timestamp) % 5) AS time, coalesce(source, 'desconocido') AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM tfm.bronze.matter_events WHERE $__timeFilter(kafka_timestamp) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Tránsito por capa en el intervalo seleccionado
panels.description: Bronze mide entregas; Silver mide eventos únicos; cuarentena es un subconjunto de Bronze; Gold mide ventanas, no eventos.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT 'Bronze' AS metric, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM tfm.bronze.matter_events WHERE $__timeFilter(kafka_timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT 'Silver' AS metric, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM tfm.silver.matter_events WHERE $__timeFilter(kafka_timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT 'Cuarentena' AS metric, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM tfm.iot_quality.quarantine_events WHERE $__timeFilter(kafka_timestamp) UNION ALL SELECT 'Gold 5 min' AS metric, CAST(count(*) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM tfm.gold.entity_5m WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start)

panels.title: Control de aceptación, duplicados y frescura por origen

targets.rawSQL: SELECT coalesce(source, 'desconocido') AS origen, count(*) AS entregas_bronze, sum(CASE WHEN quality_status = 'quarantined' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cuarentena, sum(CASE WHEN delivery_rank > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicadas, sum(CASE WHEN quality_status <> 'quarantined' AND delivery_rank = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aceptadas_unicas, max(kafka_timestamp) AS ultima_entrega FROM tfm.iot_quality.events WHERE $__timeFilter(kafka_timestamp) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY entregas_bronze DESC

panels.title: Estado de la ingesta batch AEMET
panels.description: La tabla Silver meteorológica tiene una fila por estación y día; el JSON original permanece en Bronze MinIO.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT station_id AS estacion, station_name AS nombre, province AS provincia, count(*) AS dias_cargados, min(observation_date) AS primer_dia, max(observation_date) AS ultimo_dia, max(loaded_at) AS ultima_carga FROM tfm.iot_silver.aemet_daily GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY ultimo_dia DESC
